_help: Act 2, the labour market: hiring Naguib Sabet's professional porters (hired_naguib), 45. They carry: more supplies on the road. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

fatima.speaker: fatima
fatima.line: I am Fatima el-Sayed. I place good workers with good employers, and I remember which employers were not. Naguib Sabet runs porters. If it must be carried, he carries it.

already.speaker: naguib
already.line: Loads weighed, camels shod. We are ready.

first.speaker: naguib
first.line: Naguib Sabet. Porters, camels, tents, cooks. Your expedition will not carry itself.

fee.speaker: naguib
fee.line: Forty-five pounds. And on the road, the loads are mine to decide. Overload a camel and you lose a camel.

choices.label: Agree
choices.line: Forty-five, and the loads are yours.

choices.label: I decide the loads
choices.line: Forty-five. But I decide what we carry.

joined.speaker: naguib
joined.line: Then we leave at dawn, with everything in its place.
